parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: This parameter is automatically populated when the request is sent. You do not need to specify this parameter.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the target instance. You can call the DescribeInstances operation to obtain the instance ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: ResourceName
parameters.description:
The resource name. Valid values:

- HbaseSLBThriftVip: Thrift SLB EPS resource.

- SolrSlbVip: Solr SLB EPS resource.

- PhoenixSLBQueryServerVip: Phoenix SLB EPS resource.

- PubHbaseSLBThriftVip: Thrift SLB public network resource.

- PubPhoenixSLBQueryServerVip: Phoenix SLB public network resource.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to **GLOBAL_VIP**.
